_doc: Curtain product catalog — fabric (priced per linear metre off the bolt) and track (priced per linear metre). Hand-edited. Generators consume this and emit specs/_partials/curtain-quantity-<scope-id>.md.
_pricing_rule: All curtain products priced per linear metre as ranges (fabric/colour/quality variance). Cost rollup sums min and max separately. Stock products with firm prices: set min == max.
_sizing_assumption: Drop fits within the fabric bolt width (typical 280 cm bolt handles up to ~250 cm drop with hem/heading allowance). For taller windows that exceed the bolt, the math under-counts and the spec needs a hand-edit note. Verify in store.
